verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a public REST API for the my.anydesk management console. It can list clients, retrieve session history, close active sessions, update comments and aliases, and list address books, and an open-source Python module wraps it. The API is scoped to account and session management rather than driving remote-control sessions, which are only automatable through CLI parameters, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: API control of the core remote-session functionality, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
